tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed successfully with all expected I2C, UART, and CAN devices detected, indicating no fundamental boot or enumeration failures. However, further subsystem testing is required to check for degraded components or intermittent faults.

steps.thought: I need to check the battery rest voltages next as a fast and inexpensive subsystem check before moving to more complex tests.
steps.observation: The battery_rest_check passed successfully with well-balanced cell voltages and a normal pack voltage, ruling out immediate battery rest failures or weak cells.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on self-test and battery rest check both passed without any failures, indicating a healthy unit so far.

steps.thought: I will run the esc_telemetry test to check for any commutation or synchronization errors in the ESCs, which is a low-cost and quick test.
steps.observation: The esc_telemetry test passed successfully with all four ESCs reporting back-EMF, zero sync errors, low packet loss, and normal temperatures, ruling out immediate ESC communication or synchronization issues.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on self-test, battery rest check, and ESC telemetry tests have all passed successfully without any failures.
Subsystems including motors, compass, IMU, camera, harness, and battery load still need to be evaluated before a final determination can be made.
